payload.taskDescription: Create BackupDialog with export, import, archive summary, copy/replace choice, typed replace confirmation, stage progress, actionable errors, and Open case on success. Add useBackupReminder that triggers once when a case has at least 5 cards and 1 connection, writes backupPromptedAt on dismiss or successful export, and never shows again for that case.
